cases.name: Number
cases.doc: Represents a JSON number, whether integer or floating point.

cases.name: Object

type.word: a map of text to Value

cases.more: By default the map is backed by a BTreeMap. Enable the `preserve_order` feature of serde_json to use IndexMap instead, which preserves entries in the order they are inserted into the map. In particular, this allows JSON data to be deserialized into a Value and serialized to a string while retaining the order of map keys in the input.
